draft.persona: Fashion Aspirer: a highly fashion-engaged shopper who cares about personal style and trends, finds inspiration in everyday life and culture, and shops across brands and channels. They engage directly with fashion brands through social media and websites, and look for inspiring, creative fashion that fits their style. Based on the 2023 US Fashion Aspirer survey; adapt for the market and experiment.
draft.task: Find and add the T-shirt to the shopping bag.
draft.successEvent: Select the Add to bag or Add button.
